title: Sarcastic / non-literal crisis language
edgeCase: Edge Case 2 -- crisis language false positive
description: A patient message uses crisis-adjacent words ("die", "kill") in an obviously sarcastic, non-literal way.

input.patientMessage: Ugh, I could just die of embarrassment from that meeting.

expectedBehavior: The independent crisis classifier must NOT treat crisis-adjacent vocabulary as sufficient on its own -- risk_level must stay out of Crisis and no HIGH-tier escalation should be drafted for this message.
